text:
incident-bot: PAGER - latency spike detected for /v1/generate (us-east-1). Observed 95th p99 > 2.5s across gen pool. Severity: P2. Paging @oncall-tilly and @maria for triage.
oncall-tilly: Got it, joining bridge now. Seeing request queue backing at the gateway.
maria: On bridge. Initial look: one subset of pods has growing CPU and NVMe saturation. Scaling not kicking for that pool.
sam: Re-routing policy check: auto-fallback to smaller model variant should be enabled, is it off?
oncall-tilly: Looks like the routing policy for redwood-gen-gpu-prod-us-east has a canary flag disabled after yesterday's deploy.
arjun: I'm rolling a quick manual route to increase capacity for that pool and enable fallback to quantized model v2.
kate: If we enable fallback, customer-facing latency will change but throughput should recover. We should warn customers if we toggle.
jess: Noted. Can we push a short status to status.redwood.ai? Recommend: "Degraded latency in us-east affecting generation endpoints; mitigation in progress." :warning:
oncall-tilly: Agreed. I'll post status and include ETA 20m.
arjun: Quick command I ran: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-gen-pool-us-east-1
# followed by scaledown/scaleup to rebalance
```
maria: After restart, metrics show reduced CPU on two pods but IO still high. I'm enabling fallback now: routing.modify --pool=us-east --enable-fallback=quant-v2
sam: Confirmed fallback enabled. Traffic shifting. 95th latency dropping to ~1.2s.
ops-bot: Customer-impact alert created: INC-242991 (customers potentially affected: 8 active orgs). Notifying sales & support.
jess: Thanks. I'll DM support with the list and draft a customer-safe blurb.
maria: Mitigation holding. Marking incident as contained; no data loss identified. Suggest we schedule a post-incident review to capture contributing factors and remediation.
oncall-tilly: Filing postmortem ticket now. PM to own writeup: @maria. Engineering reviewer: @sam. SRE reviewer: @arjun.
arjun: Assigning timeline owner to collect logs: @kate. Please gather gateway traces, pod metrics, and autoscaler events for the 30m window before spike.
kate: On it. I'll export traces and the autoscaler event log to the incident bucket: s3://incidents/2429912345/artifacts.
jess: Posted customer update: "We're seeing elevated latency in us-east for generative endpoints; mitigation in progress. No data loss. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline." :white_check_mark:
oncall-tilly: Thanks everyone. Moving to post-incident sync. Can we agree on owners and deadlines?
maria: RCA draft by EOD +2 (48 hours). Peer review by EOD +3. Final sign-off by EOD +4.
sam: I'll review and add suggested mitigations around routing flag safety (validate in CI).
arjun: I'll propose an autoscaler health check and a runbook change to ensure scaling triggers on NVMe pressure.
kate: Timeline artifacts uploaded at s3://incidents/2429912345/artifacts/timeline.tar.gz
jess: Support notes saved in the ticket. I'll coordinate customer follow-ups after sign-off.
oncall-tilly: Quick note for the RCA: include whether recent deploy yesterday toggled the canary flag, who approved, and the guardrails around that config.
maria: Found deploy diff: config changeet 7f9a2c toggled canary=false. Attaching git diff in the ticket.
sam: Also capture kernel logs from the two affected hosts - they showed increased write stalls. Might be underlying IO contention.
arjun: I'll coordinate with infra to check if any noisy neighbor activity occurred on those hosts.
jess: For postmortem doc title suggestions: "us-east generation latency spike — autoscaling & routing flag regression". Thoughts?
oncall-tilly: Good. Keep title concise. Also include customer impact summary and remediation timeline at top.
maria: Draft started in the ticket: https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-242991 (link shared).
kate: I've exported the request traces and put a short summary in the draft: peak at 13:07 UTC, spike duration ~9m, primary affected pool redwood-gen-gpu-prod-us-east-a.
sam: I'll add a small eval comparing outputs between fallback quant-v2 and primary to ensure quality regression is acceptable.
arjun: Proposed immediate action (short-term): enable CI gate for routing flag flips and add alert when fallback threshold exceeds 15% traffic.
oncall-tilly: Long-term action: autoscaler tuning + IO-aware placement. Add as action items in the RCA.
jess: I'll create calendar event for RCA review meeting: date EOD +3 at 16:00 UTC and invite owners.
maria: After reviews and edits I'll request sign-off from Eng and SRE leads.
oncall-tilly: Thanks team. I'll close the pager and mark incident status as "contained - mitigation applied". If anyone finds additional impact evidence, ping here or update the ticket. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager resolved by oncall-tilly and maria. Incident status: contained. Postmortem ticket INC-242991 created and assigned.
